name: GlassMoodRing
material_impl: OptimizedGlass shell (level2/neutral) plus stacked redundant classes 'glass-backdrop-blur-md border border-border/20'. Ring itself is a bordered div with inline borderColor and `0 0 20px ${color}40` glow. Colors built by string-concatenating a hex alpha onto mood.color, but default moods use 'hsl(var(--glass-color-*))' / 'var(--glass-color-secondary)', producing invalid CSS (e.g. 'hsl(var(--x))cc') so the center fill and intensity-ring borders silently drop. Hard-coded #32CD32/#FF6347/#98FB98 mixed with tokens.
motion: Motion presets + Tailwind animate-pulse on center and all 3 intensity rings (infinite) + animate-spin overlay. Uses useMotionPreferenceContext whose default is prefersReducedMotion:false, so OS reduced-motion is ignored unless the app mounts MotionPreferenceProvider; useReducedMotion imported but unused. Dynamic Tailwind class `duration-[${ANIMATION.DURATION.slower}ms]` can never be generated by JIT.
a11y: Ring is role=button tabIndex=0 with Enter/Space; when non-interactive it becomes role=status with tabIndex=-1. Swatch buttons are 24px (w-6 h-6), below 44px touch target, label via aria-label; selected state communicated only by a white ring (no aria-pressed). Mood label text colored with the mood color itself (contrast not guaranteed). No live region for mood changes.
api: forwardRef, className + rest passthrough; size sm|md|lg|xl, thickness, glowIntensity. 'mood' prop is only an initial value (not controlled - never synced after mount). Toggle 'Auto' button only renders when autoTransition is set.
ssr: 'use client'; no module-scope window access. Plays sounds on change via useGlassSound.
fake_complexity: biometricIntegration is Math.random() every 10s ('This would normally connect to actual biometric sensors', L230-243); ambientResponse is a clock-hour lookup. Shows 'Bio' / 'Ambient' badges implying sensing that does not exist.
duplicates: Conceptually overlaps status-dot/indicator and avatar-ring patterns; no other mood component in library. Stale-closure handleMoodChange used inside interval effects not listed in deps.
justification: A novelty widget whose headline features (biometric, ambient) are random/clock fakes, whose default palette produces invalid CSS colors because hex alpha is appended to hsl(var()) strings, and which pulses indefinitely while ignoring OS reduced-motion by default. It has no plausible place in a premium first-party system; if a status ring is needed it should be rebuilt as a small token-driven indicator, not salvaged.

name: GlassToast (feedback)
material_impl: Glass primitive + glass-surface-{success,danger,warning,info} utility classes; progress bar via inline var(--glass-primary-level3-surface). Injects a global '@keyframes shrink' <style> per toast instance (name collides with the same keyframe in data-display/GlassNotificationCenter).
motion: CSS transform/opacity transition 300ms; useReducedMotion respected (instant enter/exit, progress bar hidden).
a11y: Each toast role=status aria-live=polite (error toasts should be assertive/alert). Dismiss button renders bare '✕' with NO aria-label and 20px size despite glass-touch-target class. Emoji icons (✅❌⚠️ℹ️) read aloud. No pause-on-hover/focus; auto-dismiss timer not cleared on manual dismiss (setTimeout leak, removeToast captured before definition).
api: Exports ToastProvider/useToast/useToastHelpers/GlassToast but none reach the root barrel. GlassToast itself is a demo wrapper that renders demo buttons when no children. useToast silently returns no-op context outside provider. Not forwardRef.
ssr: 'use client'; portal-less fixed container rendered inline (z-50), no SSR hazards.
fake_complexity: GlassToast default export is a demo harness (ToastDemoControls), not a toast.
duplicates: Direct duplicate of the exported src/components/data-display/GlassToast.tsx + GlassToastProvider.tsx (root exports those at src/index.ts:317-324); also overlaps GlassNotificationCenter.
justification: Non-exported legacy duplicate of the shipped data-display toast system with a demo-harness as its main component, an unlabeled emoji close button, and a global keyframe collision. Nothing public depends on it; fold any useful bits (reduced-motion handling, position map) into the canonical GlassToastProvider and delete this file and its stories.

name: GlassErrorBoundary (components/)
material_impl: GlassAdvanced elev=3 variant=danger; ContrastGuard; glass-button utility classes. Reasonable reuse of primitives.
a11y: role=alert aria-live=assertive on fallback; buttons have aria-label. Class string duplicates glass-focus/glass-touch-target 3x. Leading emoji in heading. Copy claims 'The issue has been logged and our team will investigate' - false for a library.
api: Class component; wraps children in an extra <div> even when no error (layout side-effect). 'Go Home' hard-navigates window.location.href='/'. Sends gtag exceptions if window.gtag exists - undeclared analytics side effect. No resetKeys.
ssr: 'use client'; window access only in handlers/didCatch. Imports '@/lib/utils' alias.
fake_complexity: None, but the fallback copy is misleading product copy.
duplicates: Root exports GlassErrorBoundary from src/utils/errorBoundary.tsx (src/index.ts:1026-1032) - this is a same-named shadow implementation; also hooks/useErrorBoundary.tsx.
justification: Same-named duplicate of the exported utils/errorBoundary GlassErrorBoundary. It adds an unconditional wrapper div, implicit gtag telemetry, a hard redirect to '/', and false 'our team will investigate' copy. Delete it and keep one canonical boundary, adding resetKeys and a configurable fallback there.

name: HoudiniGlassCard (+ HoudiniGlassShowcase)
material_impl: Bespoke: relies on '.houdini-glass' CSS injected at runtime by HoudiniGlassProvider (blur(24px) saturate(1.5), rgba(255 255 255/.28) gradient) - without the provider the card gets only utility classes. Showcase buttons use hard-coded inline rgba(255,255,255,.12/.28) backgrounds/borders. Mixed raw Tailwind ('flex items-center gap-2 p-2 rounded-lg') with glass-* utilities; nonsense class repeats ('glass-gradient-primary' x5).
motion: framer-motion whileHover scale 1.02 and overlay fade; useReducedMotion zeroes durations, but whileHover scale still applies. getPerformanceIndicator() calls useReducedMotion() inside a nested function rendered conditionally on showControls - a Rules-of-Hooks violation that changes hook order when showControls toggles.
a11y: Settings toggle is an icon-only button with only title (no aria-label/aria-expanded). Status dots convey state by color with title only. Emoji ✅/❌ for support state.
api: Plain function, no forwardRef, no rest/style passthrough, children required. effects/preset strings untyped (string[]).
ssr: 'use client'; framer-motion import; depends on provider injecting <style> into document.head in effect.
fake_complexity: Claims Paint Worklet effects ('frost', 'caustics', 'refraction'); useGlassEffect sets background-image: paint(glass-frost) etc. but no worklet module is ever registered (addModule calls are commented out in the provider), so on Chromium the paint() images are invalid/blank and the 'effects' do nothing.
duplicates: Overlaps GlassCard / LiquidGlassMaterial / LiquidGlassGPU and the OptimizedGlass primitive; HoudiniGlassShowcase is a demo page exported as a public component.
justification: Sells CSS Houdini paint effects that are never registered, so the card is really a hard-coded rgba/blur card that depends on runtime-injected global CSS. It breaks hook rules, skips forwardRef and style passthrough, and its showcase is exported as public API. Deprecate it in favour of the canonical card on the shared material. Real Houdini enhancement, if wanted, belongs inside the material primitive, not a parallel card.

name: HoudiniGlassProvider (+ useHoudiniGlass, useGlassEffect, glassPresets)
material_impl: Injects a global <style> with hard-coded backdrop-filter blur(24px) saturate(1.5) brightness(1.08) contrast(1.04) and rgba whites; writes --glass-background/--glass-blur/--glass-shadow etc. onto document.documentElement, globally overriding design tokens for the whole page. registerProperty declares '--glass-background' with syntax <color> and initialValue 'var(--glass-bg-default)' (invalid - initial values must be computationally independent, so registration throws and is swallowed).
motion: CSS transition with reduced-motion media query in injected CSS.
a11y: Debug panel role=status. Otherwise non-visual wrapper div.
api: forwardRef wrapper div + context; useHoudiniGlass returns a default context outside provider. 'enabledEffects' prop default array literal is a new identity each render and is an effect dependency (L255) - re-runs the performance effect every render.
ssr: 'use client'; all DOM writes inside effects. Mutates documentElement inline styles and never cleans them up on unmount; multiple providers fight over globals; window.__AURAGLASS_*_REGISTERED__ globals.
fake_complexity: Self-labelled @demo. registerGlassWorklets is a no-op (addModule lines commented out, 'Mock functions' comment L436); 'performanceMode' just toggles which strings are in an array.
duplicates: Overlaps ThemeProvider/GlassEffects context, LiquidGlassLayerProvider, token CSS. glassPresets name collides conceptually with other preset maps.
justification: This is a mock of CSS Houdini. Its worklets are never loaded, its property registrations use invalid var() initial values, and it overwrites global design tokens on <html> with no cleanup. That is hostile to a token-driven system and unsafe when two instances mount. Remove it along with HoudiniGlassCard. If progressive Houdini enhancement is ever wanted, build it inside the canonical material primitive with real worklet modules.

name: ClearIcon
a11y: No aria-hidden/role/title; when onClick is passed the SVG becomes a pointer-clickable non-focusable, non-keyboard control. Used inside buttons in GlassMultiSelect, where it should be aria-hidden.
api: React.FC, no forwardRef, no SVG prop spread (types.ts declares a different ClearIconProps extending SVGAttributes - two conflicting prop types).
ssr: Unneeded 'use client' on a pure SVG.
duplicates: Duplicate of icons/components.tsx X / XIcon / CloseIcon (src/icons/components.tsx:870,906).
justification: Internal one-off X icon duplicating the icon package, with a clickable-SVG anti-pattern and conflicting prop types. Replace its two uses in GlassMultiSelect with the canonical XIcon (aria-hidden), then delete the file, its story and its test.

name: ImageList (+ GlassImageList)
material_impl: CSS module using --aura-color-glass-surface/border/shadow and --aura-glass-neutral-level2-backdrop-blur tokens - token-correct, the cleanest material in this shard. No hard-coded colors.
a11y: Semantic <ul>; but items may be role=button (see ImageListItem) which breaks list semantics; cloned className injection 'galileo-image-list-item' (legacy brand leftover).
api: forwardRef, but ref is assigned in useEffect (late and never cleared on unmount) instead of being passed to the element. MUI-clone API (cols, rowHeight, variant standard|quilted|masonry|woven) - quilted and woven are effectively the same as standard. Dead props: rounded, enableEntranceAnimation, animationConfig, disableAnimation, motionSensitivity (any-typed).
fake_complexity: Variants 'quilted'/'woven' are named but not implemented beyond grid-auto-flow: dense.
duplicates: Overlaps layouts/GlassMasonryGrid.tsx and layout/GlassMasonry.tsx (masonry variant), media/LiquidGlassPhotoInspector galleries.
justification: Small and token-correct, and a reasonable media grid primitive. It needs a direct ref, removal of the dead animation props and the 'galileo' class, real or removed quilted/woven variants, and a decision on whether masonry lives here or in GlassMasonryGrid; consolidate the masonry implementations into one. The material approach (CSS module plus aura tokens) is the pattern other components should copy.

name: ImageListItem (+ GlassImageListItem)
material_impl: CSS module with aura glass tokens; focus ring and elevation shadows have rgba(99,102,241,…)/rgba(15,23,42,…) fallbacks behind token vars.
motion: CSS scale 1.03 on hover/focus via CSS var; useReducedMotion disables. Fine.
a11y: Interactive items get role=button on an <li> (removes listitem semantics); non-interactive items get forced aria-label='Image in gallery' overriding content; aria-expanded='true' set on hover when hoverOverlay (wrong semantics). Visible focus ring present (:focus-visible).
api:
forwardRef. `...rest` is spread onto BOTH the and the
  • (L163, L230), so unknown props (intent, tier - declared in types but unused) leak to DOM as invalid attributes and any handler passed lands twice. cols/rows ternary is a no-op (variableSize ? 1 : 1). elevation typed as string union but default 0.
fake_complexity: 'intent' and 'tier' props are declared but do nothing.
duplicates: Paired with ImageList; overlaps gallery/masonry items.
justification: The material and motion are sound. The API and ARIA are buggy: rest props are spread twice and leak to the DOM, role=button on an li breaks list semantics, aria-expanded is misused on hover, and intent/tier are dead props. Fix it by rendering an inner <button> for interactive items, keeping the li semantic, spreading rest props once, and deleting the dead props.

name: ImageListItemBar (+ GlassImageListItemBar)
material_impl: CSS module with aura tokens; text color hard-coded to rgba(var(--glass-color-black)/.95) for title/subtitle, so the bar is dark-text-only and illegible on dark/photographic glass in dark themes; color-mix with black tint.
motion: Opacity transition with reduced-motion handling in both JS and CSS.
a11y: showOnHover reveal is mouse-only (no :focus-within), so keyboard users never see the bar's actions (pointer-events:none while hidden). Title is a div, not heading/figcaption.
api: forwardRef (untyped generic on base), className/style/rest. title/subtitle typed string only (no ReactNode).
justification: Simple and close to acceptable. Swap the hard-coded black text for an on-glass text token so it works in dark themes, reveal on :focus-within as well as hover, accept ReactNode titles, and render as a figcaption. Keep it as part of the ImageList family.

name: GlassImageProcessingProvider (ImageProcessingProvider)
api: Exported from root but its consumer hook useImageProcessing is NOT exported (src/index.ts:716 only), so external apps cannot read the context - the provider is only usable by GlassIntelligentImageUploader. Not forwardRef; passes 'data-glass-component' onto Context.Provider (ignored). 30+ method surface, most stubs.
ssr: 'use client'; reads process.env.IMAGE_SERVICE_URL (non-public) in client code; new Image()/document.createElement in callbacks only.
fake_complexity: Self-labelled @demo. analyzeImage returns Math.random brightness/contrast after 1s; detectFaces returns 0-3 random faces with random landmarks; optimizeImage appends '?optimized=true&q=85' to a blob: URL (which breaks the object URL); compressionRatio is random; removeBackground waits 3s and flips hasAlpha; rotate/replaceBackground/upscale return the input unchanged; uploadToCloud returns https://cloudinary.example.com URLs; templates use dead via.placeholder.com thumbnails. Functional bugs: addImage auto-optimize calls optimizeImage via a stale getImage closure -> 'Image not found' unhandled rejection; createImageFromFile creates two object URLs and leaks one; draws to an unused canvas.
duplicates: Overlaps input/GlassFileUpload and any AI/media service providers.
justification: This 1.4k-line mock 'AI image service' fakes analysis, face detection, optimization and cloud upload with Math.random and setTimeout. It returns example.com URLs and corrupts blob URLs, and its context hook isn't even exported. Shipping it in a design system is a liability: it implies capabilities that do not exist. Remove it from the package, or at most move it to a demo/examples workspace.

name: GlassIntelligentImageUploader

stories.note: also GlassIntelligentImageProcessor.stories.tsx (47 lines) with no matching component file

material_impl: Glass primitive shell; inner surfaces via glass-surface-* utilities; mixes raw Tailwind 'bg-red-500'/'bg-blue-500'/'h-2 rounded-full' and inline style overrides (padding:12, overflow hidden, display:grid). Editor modal backdrop uses utilities. Unicode glyphs (◎ ⇧ ⌁ ↯) as iconography instead of the icon set.
motion: Spinner animate-spin, hover scale; no reduced-motion handling.
a11y: Editor is a fixed overlay without role=dialog, aria-modal, focus trap, Escape, or labelled title; close button is a bare '✕' without aria-label. Dropzone div is not keyboard-focusable (only the inner button works). Filter range inputs have <label> not associated (no htmlFor/id). Hover-only overlay actions (Edit/Remove) invisible to keyboard/touch. Progress bars lack role=progressbar.
api: React.FC, no forwardRef, no rest/style passthrough. Requires the provider for any persistent state: under the default context addImages returns objects that are never stored, so uploads silently disappear. handleDrop is useCallback([]) capturing the first-render handleFiles (stale maxFiles/images.length). Several buttons have no handler (Crop & Resize, Add Watermark, Download, Batch Optimize, Batch Download).
ssr: 'use client'; DataTransfer constructed in handler only.
fake_complexity: Marketed as 'AI-powered image optimization and editing' with 'Reduce file sizes by up to 80%' copy; all AI actions route to the mock provider; filter sliders never change the previewed image (no CSS filter/canvas applied).
duplicates: Overlaps input/GlassFileUpload.tsx (the real upload control) and media/LiquidGlassPhotoInspector.
justification: A demo uploader that fronts a fake AI backend. It has at least five dead buttons, filters that don't affect the preview, a modal without dialog semantics or focus management, and uploads that vanish without the unexported provider. Remove it with the provider. If a premium image dropzone is needed, extend GlassFileUpload with real preview, accessible drop target and progress.

name: Glass360Viewer
material_impl: OptimizedGlass shell + controls bar (level3/strong) with redundant glass-backdrop-blur-md/border classes. Canvas hotspots use fillStyle 'hsl(var(--glass-color-primary))' and strokeStyle 'var(--glass-white)' - canvas cannot resolve CSS vars, so these assignments are ignored and hotspots draw in default black. Dynamic Tailwind 'duration-[${...}ms]' classes never generated.
motion: rAF render loop; auto-rotate via setState every frame, and currentView is a dependency of the rAF effect, so the loop is torn down and recreated every frame while rotating. Uses useMotionPreference (matchMedia-backed) to gate the hotspot pulse only - auto-rotate is NOT disabled under reduced motion.
a11y: Drag/wheel only; no keyboard panning, no aria on canvas, no text alternative for the scene. Control buttons are emoji (🔄 📱 🗖 ▶ 🎛) with title only, no aria-label/aria-pressed. Fullscreen state not synced with fullscreenchange (Esc leaves state stale).
api: forwardRef + rest passthrough; rich props (sources, controls, quality, performanceMode, minZoom/maxZoom) of which sources, quality (config computed then unused), performanceMode, maxZoom/minZoom, vr and volume are ignored.
fake_complexity: Not a 360 viewer: 'projection' is a source-rect crop of 1/4 of the equirectangular image (no spherical reprojection, no wrap at the seam); cubemap/cylindrical/dome are ignored; fov is tracked and displayed but never affects rendering, so wheel 'zoom' changes a number only. The canvas is never sized (default 300x150 bitmap stretched to the container -> blurry). React onWheel preventDefault is passive and does not block page scroll. Certification DOM inspection recorded hasCanvas:false for this story, i.e. the canvas was not present at capture.
duplicates: Overlaps media/LiquidGlassPhotoInspector; no other panorama viewer.
justification: The name promises a 360° panorama viewer. The implementation crops a rectangle of a flat image onto an unsized 300x150 canvas: zoom, projections, VR and quality are no-ops, and hotspots render black because canvas ignores CSS variables. A correct viewer needs WebGL spherical projection, which is out of scope for a glass design system and is better left to dedicated libraries. Remove it. At most, offer a glass controls overlay that wraps a third-party viewer.

name: GlassARPreview
material_impl: OptimizedGlass shell + 3 nested OptimizedGlass panels; raw Tailwind bg-red-500/20, text-red-400, bg-green-500, bg-gray-500 mixed in. Canvas fillStyle uses 'rgba(var(--glass-color-black) / …)', 'hsl(var(--glass-color-primary))', 'var(--glass-white)', 'var(--glass-text-secondary-dark)' - all invalid for canvas, so objects/labels/debug render in whatever fillStyle was last valid (black).
motion: Continuous rAF loop (renderScene recreated on every dependency change); 'pulse'/'rotate' object animations apply ctx.scale/rotate AFTER drawing and are immediately restored - no visible effect. useReducedMotion imported, unused; loop runs regardless of reduced motion.
a11y: Canvas-only objects; selection via mouse click only; no keyboard access, no text alternative; status chip not a live region.
api: forwardRef + rest; huge prop surface (markers, lighting, environmentMap, quality, xrMode, onObjectMove/Rotate/Scale, renderObject) with most ignored: lighting/environmentMap/config unused, renderObject branch is empty, move/rotate/scale callbacks never fired.
ssr: 'use client'; navigator/window inside effects. Camera effect lists cameraStream in its deps and calls setCameraStream inside -> with background='camera' it re-requests getUserMedia on every stream update (infinite permission/stream churn), stopping only the previous-previous stream.
fake_complexity: Self-labelled @demo: no WebXR session is ever started ('In a real implementation, this would start WebXR session'); marker 'tracking' is setInterval + Math.random found/lost; markers are drawn at random positions each frame (flicker); canvas DPR scaling then hit-testing in device pixels mis-targets clicks on HiDPI screens.
duplicates: None functional; overlaps the other immersive canvas demos.
justification: A fake AR component. There is no XR session, tracking is random, renderObject and the lighting props are dead, and canvas colors are invalid. In camera mode a dependency bug loops getUserMedia, which is a privacy and battery hazard. It cannot be polished into a real AR feature inside a design system. Remove it from the public API.

name: GlassFluidSimulation
material_impl: OptimizedGlass shell + controls panel; controls override text tokens inline to black (rgba(var(--glass-color-black)/.9)) and force colorScheme light - breaks dark themes. Canvas strokes use named colors 'red'/'blue'/'purple'/'green'/'yellow'. Canvas fixed 800x600 inline width/height (no responsive sizing, overflows mobile).
motion: rAF + setState per frame of all particles. animate depends on render, which depends on particleHistory/fps/mousePos (all updated every frame), so the rAF effect is cancelled and re-registered every frame. Under reduced motion (only via MotionPreferenceProvider context; default ignores OS) the loop returns immediately and nothing is ever drawn - blank canvas instead of a static frame.
a11y: Canvas has no role/label/text alternative. Controls: 'Trails' checkbox is bound to the showTrails prop and only clears history; 'Debug' checkbox onChange is a no-op; preset select changes state but the preset effect body is empty - three controls that look functional do nothing.
api: forwardRef + rest; many physics props. 'preset' does not apply any preset (L235-239). 'paused' prop only seeds initial state.
fake_complexity: Labeled SPH but is an O(n^2) naive neighbor loop with density clamped to restDensity (pressure always >= 0). Particles are mutated in place inside setState and history stores shallow array copies of the same mutated objects, so 'trails' render the current positions repeatedly instead of history.
duplicates: Overlaps GlassParticleField, GlassVortexPortal, advanced/GlassParticles, backgrounds/ParticleBackground, effects/SeasonalParticles (5+ canvas particle systems).
justification: A toy O(n^2) particle demo branded as an SPH fluid simulation. Trails are broken by in-place mutation, the preset, debug and trails controls are no-ops, it uses a fixed 800px canvas, re-subscribes rAF every frame, and draws nothing under reduced motion. It is not a design-system component. Remove it. If ambient liquid motion is wanted, it belongs in one consolidated, GPU-backed background effect.

name: GlassHologram
material_impl: OptimizedGlass shell with inline radial-gradient background built as `${colors.primary}10`; for blue/green/red/white schemes primary is 'hsl(var(--…))' or 'var(--glass-white)', so the concatenated hex alpha makes the background, grid lines, scanlines, shape fills and drop-shadows invalid CSS. Hard-coded hex palettes for purple/cyan/rainbow (#FF0080/#00FF80/#8000FF). Injects global @keyframes named 'float', 'noise', 'interference' (generic names colliding with app CSS) per instance.
motion: setAnimationTime every rAF frame re-renders the entire component at 60fps. Render-time Math.random in background 'matrix'/'particles' and glitch means positions re-randomize every frame (constant jitter). Reduced motion via context only (OS ignored by default).
a11y: role=region aria-label present. Layers have pointerEvents:'none' unless already selected, so they can never be clicked to select (onClick unreachable). Emoji control buttons with title only.
api: forwardRef + rest, but rest is spread after style so a consumer style prop replaces width/height/background entirely. containerRef is never attached to any element, so handleMouseMove always returns early and 'interactive' does nothing; if it were wired it would accumulate angle per mousemove event (runaway spin). customShaders, ambientLight, depthOfField unused.
ssr: 'use client'; render-time Math.random -> hydration mismatch if SSR'd.
fake_complexity: Not a hologram: CSS 3D transforms on absolutely positioned divs plus scanline gradients; 'customShaders' prop does nothing.
duplicates: Overlaps effects/holographic and shimmer effects, GlassParticleField background particles.
justification: A sci-fi decoration with severe correctness bugs. Interaction is unwired (detached containerRef), layers cannot be selected (pointer-events none), positions re-randomize every frame, half the color schemes emit invalid CSS, and the whole tree re-renders at 60fps. It carries generic global keyframe names and does nothing a premium glass system needs. Remove it.

name: GlassParticleField
material_impl: OptimizedGlass shell overridden by inline background 'rgba(255,255,255,0.22)' (hard-coded, defeats tint/theme). Canvas colors properly sanitized via resolveCanvasColor (rejects var() strings) - the only canvas component here that handles the CSS-var problem. Hard-coded hex palettes per colorScheme. Canvas bitmap fixed to bounds (360x240) while CSS width is 100% (blurry when stretched, no DPR).
motion: rAF with setState of whole particle array every frame plus setParticleCount inside the updater (setState-in-updater). When paused the loop keeps spinning rAF doing nothing. Seeds a deterministic static constellation for reduced motion (good), but reduced-motion detection uses context only (OS ignored by default).
a11y: role=region + aria-label. Play/pause is an emoji button with title only. Decorative canvas not aria-hidden.
api: forwardRef, className/style merged sensibly. Unused props: collisions, physics, performance (culling/lodDistance), effects.sparkle; 'renderParticle' renders a DOM node per particle (up to maxParticles=1000) - perf trap.
fake_complexity: Moderate: real simple particle physics, but 'collisions', 'culling', 'LOD', 'bloom' are names without implementations (bloom = CSS drop-shadow).
duplicates: Strong overlap with advanced/GlassParticles.tsx, backgrounds/ParticleBackground.tsx, effects/SeasonalParticles(.r3f).tsx, GlassFluidSimulation, GlassVortexPortal particles.
justification: The least broken of the immersive canvases: colors are sanitized and there is a reduced-motion static seed. It is still one of five or more overlapping particle systems, with dead feature props, hard-coded white fill, setState-per-frame rendering and no DPR handling. Merge its good ideas (deterministic seed, color sanitizer) into one ambient particle background that keeps state in refs, is DPR-aware, sits behind content as aria-hidden, and reads OS reduced motion. Then delete this one.

name: GlassVortexPortal
material_impl: OptimizedGlass shell; canvas has a hard-coded light gradient background, and each frame fillRect('rgba(0,0,0,0.1)') accumulates over it, so the light canvas progressively darkens to near-black. COLOR_SCHEMES were desaturated to near-gray (e.g. 'blue' = [210,216,224]) so schemes are indistinguishable. Hard-coded rgba throughout.
motion: rAF + three setStates per frame. updateRings multiplies ring.opacity by currentIntensity EVERY frame (opacity: ring.opacity * currentIntensity) and updateParticles does the same for particle opacity, so with intensity 0.8 rings/particles decay exponentially to invisible within ~1s; particle lifetime decremented by 0.016 from thousands so particles never expire. opening/closing timers not cleared on unmount. Reduced motion via context only.
a11y: Canvas without label; Type select, Color select and Pulse/Distortion/Debug checkboxes all have onChange={() => {}} - five controls that do nothing (and controlled checkboxes without handlers).
api: forwardRef + rest; 'type' prop (dimensional/energy/void/quantum/temporal) is never read by rendering; distortion types unused.
fake_complexity: 'dimensional distortion', 'quantum', 'temporal', 'event horizon' are radial gradients; type has no effect.
justification: Its control panel is mostly inert: type, color and three toggles are empty onChange handlers. The core animation decays itself to nothing through per-frame opacity multiplication, and the canvas darkens to black over the light gradient. Thirteen stories and a 'certified' screenshot mask a component that does not work as named. Remove it.
